description: Build-time ACP runtime base snapshot with selected upstream overlays; MIT license in LICENSE. No external checkout required.

overlays.adaptation: Crypto service calls retain the pinned Effect 4.0.5 API. SelectProviderOptionDescriptor.role and sessionConfig reasoning role are cherry-picked from this revision.
Ancestor-chain realPath canonicalization for symlink-safe workspace containment (retained writeAntigravityClientTextFile and hardened isInsideRoot separator boundary).
Reject non-UTF-8 and NUL-containing binary files in readAntigravityClientTextFile.
Only approved execute tool calls may grant terminal execution; retains backward-compatible fallback on legacy kind when toolKind is omitted.
Decode each terminal pipe stream independently as UTF-8 while preserving literal BOMs.
Bound stdout/stderr drain grace after process exit so background children holding pipes do not hang wait_for_exit.
Only chmod an extracted executable after confirming its realPath stays inside the installation root (with path separator boundary check).

localPatches: provider-acp initial activation owns native restoration once and tries the advertised alternate restoration method without creating a replacement session
contracts ProviderAuthMethod and registry auth retain normalized envVarNames and link metadata for generic env_var credential forms
provider-acp runtimeModel projects v2 state_update notifications to the host bridge
provider-core ProviderAuthFlow passes an optional forceReauthentication flag from the host to authentication without changing the default for existing callers
provider-acp-registry auth verifies an existing native session before ordinary login; only ACP auth-required permits interactive login; forced reauthentication remains explicit
provider-acp-registry auth projects the validated CodeBuddy private authUrl notification as a browser handoff, without opening it again or treating it as success
provider-acp runtime authenticate selects its protocol method lazily after initialize negotiates the ACP generation
provider-acp-registry AcpRegistrySupport selects System32 bsdtar via cliArchiveTarCommand on all win32 archive extractions instead of bare tar
provider-acp clientPolicy makeAcpClientPolicyGrants converts turn-level execute approvals into single-use turnCredits with consumeExecute(turnKey)
provider-acp clientPolicy acpMcpToolApprovalElicitationDisposition denies silent allow when sandboxPolicy.type is readOnly
apps/server AntigravityAuth exposes controller.isChangingCredentials reflecting real operation state

DSH host namespace adaptation (DSH_ACP_MCP_* and clientInfo/serverId 'dsh-acp-agents') across AcpMcpStdioBridge.ts, AntigravityInstallation.ts, effect-acp/src/client.ts, mcpOverAcpBridge.ts, and t3McpToolPresentation.ts
